baseline.currentTraditionalReaderRoute: existing JSC; retained original-rule JVM coordinator is not yet routed into product reading

policy.sourceCompatibilityTarget: Locked original Legado archive; native reading experience may improve beyond original UI.
policy.completionMeasure: Observable feature/protocol/data/runtime contracts with source-specific evidence; test counts and source counts are not completion percentages.
policy.unsupportedBehavior: Return explicit capability/error information; do not fabricate successful empty results or silently switch rule engines.
policy.backgroundBoundary: Foreground services and system-permitted scheduling only; do not promise persistent servers or precise background Cron.
policy.legalBoundary: Preserve original license partitions, attribution and source obligations; this plan is implementation/material work, not legal advice or a clearance determination.

execution.schedulingRule: A workpackage may start after its explicit workpackage dependencies are met; stage dependencies define integration checkpoints, not a reason to idle independent work.
execution.validationRule: Run focused regressions after final related edits; batch compatible cloud checks in one ordinary payload/build, retain raw reports, and do not repeat unchanged passing checks without a new concern.
execution.progressRule: Report the bounded batch, evidence, unresolved limits and next checkpoint; do not silently open an unbounded new cloud loop.
execution.terminalNonDeviceState: All implementable desktop/Simulator tasks verified, external/device-dependent feasibility decisions explicit, one audited source-free candidate and concise deferred checklist. Do not mark the full feature domains complete while required evidence is missing.

workpackages.objective: Maintain this executable ledger and add current-state corrections to stale docs without rewriting historical audits.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: All 64 feature-catalog IDs have exactly one domain-owner workpackage; task and stage dependencies are acyclic.
Separate code present, measured desktop behavior, real ordinary-JAR native execution, Simulator UI and device acceptance.
Update stale claims that the coordinator is uncommitted or current branding unbuilt, preserving historical sourceHEAD, hashes and raw reports.

workpackages.objective: Fix and directly test reading-position store write integrity before broader reading UX work.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: Inspect the existing store's actual write/read path and repair the root cause within that store.
Dedicated regression proves required progress updates are not silently lost on persistence failure and that later successful persistence preserves the intended latest position.
Preserve stable (spineIndex, charOffset) semantics and existing on-disk compatibility; do not add a parallel position store.
deferredDeviceAcceptance: Verify background/foreground and cold-launch progress continuity on the signed final device build.

workpackages.objective: Make waiting on same-key scope initialization cancellation-aware without changing original shared-state semantics.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: Regression enters a real blocked initialization and cancels a second same-key waiter; completion must follow the cancellation signal rather than a settle delay.
Retain same-key single initialization, independent-key progress, no partial-scope publication, close behavior and creation-lock cleanup.
Run focused coordinator regressions and reuse the existing exact stateful baseline; preserve disclosed exception-label differences.
deferredDeviceAcceptance: Verify cancellation and resource recovery in ordinary-JAR native product sessions after the completed coordinator is routed into the app.

workpackages.objective: Expose current font size and labeled brightness values to assistive technology in the existing quick reading panel.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: Font-size increase/decrease buttons expose the current displayed font-size value through accessibilityValue.
The existing brightness slider has a localized accessibility label and a percentage accessibilityValue matching the on-screen state.
Decorative sun symbols are hidden from accessibility without hiding actual controls.
Extend the existing TXT reopen UI test method to verify the same current values and retained reading position; reuse the same cloud build and test run.
This is a bounded accessibility improvement; do not describe additional fonts, new themes or a new reading settings system as implemented.
deferredDeviceAcceptance: Verify VoiceOver speaks the controls, current font size and brightness percentage correctly on final hardware.

workpackages.objective: Improve comfort and clarity using existing native controls, CoreText rendering and reusable appearance settings.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: Keep the two licensed bundled Chinese fonts and user font import; evaluate a sample-text preview plus font-size/line-spacing presets before adding more font assets or new controls.
Verify changing font/size/spacing, rotation and page-to-scroll transitions retain the same semantic reading anchor.
Evaluate low-brightness night reading, high-contrast text, Reduce Motion, VoiceOver labels and large text using native settings.
Verify iPad split-view width changes, controls and navigation preserve the reading anchor and avoid clipped content.
Every adopted change names its user problem and includes the smallest meaningful UI/layout evidence; do not add duplicate appearance or pagination systems.
deferredDeviceAcceptance: Check font comfort, physical screen brightness, real gestures, VoiceOver usability and iPad split-screen reading on hardware.

workpackages.objective: Measure startup, long-chapter navigation and offline/prefetch behavior, then change only the measured bottleneck.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: Define repeatable fixture sizes, build mode, phase spans, metrics and acceptance thresholds before optimization; distinguish Debug XCTest-host stalls from product benchmarks.
Measure app startup, opening a cached long chapter, chapter switching, repagination and peak memory on fixed fixtures; record before/after with matching environment.
Evaluate on-demand bounded prefetch and offline recovery through the existing download/cache repository only.
Cancel obsolete prefetch on source/book changes; distinguish missing cache, corrupted cache and legitimate empty content; do not silently retry an internal parsing error.
No startup, memory, package-size or smoothness improvement claim without an appropriate before/after measurement.
deferredDeviceAcceptance: Measure cold/warm startup, sustained scrolling/paging, memory pressure, battery/thermal behavior, network transitions and background behavior on final hardware.

workpackages.objective: Complete inspectable release materials and identify unresolved rights/combination decisions without making an unsupported legal-clearance claim.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: Retain MPL, Legado GPLv3-default file partitions, Oracle GPLv2/ClassPath-exception partitions, engine notices and all original modification/source attributions.
Explicitly inventory the ios-tools AGPLv3 root and injected symbol_keeper.cpp/native-object boundary; do not hide this behind a generic MPL/GPL/ClassPath label.
Collect exact engine/JDK/native/dependency source versions, all patches and required build/install inputs; verify complete corresponding-source retrieval rather than only hashes and license texts.
Expand resolved transitive dependency, font, artwork, sample-book/data and static-object/header inventories; source locks alone do not establish rights.
Check actual final IPA notice/source/brand bytes against the immutable release commit and materials; preserve historical audits as historical.
Record remaining legal/rights decisions as unresolved when evidence is insufficient; materials completion is distinct from legal redistribution clearance.

workpackages.objective: Keep the phone-only reader self-renewal requirement as an honest transport/install feasibility gate.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: Document current read-only probe behavior and bounded transport hypotheses; a fixed-loopback failure cannot rule out every transport.

Prepare protocol/state-machine boundaries, bounded discovery design, credential/pairing-data protection, cancellation/timeouts and reproducible diagnostic instructions without collecting real secrets.
Plan signing/profile freshness, same-identity replacement, crash-safe handover and data-preservation checks without claiming they are implemented.
Do not integrate a signer or additional AGPL renewal dependency before an authenticated same-device installation transport satisfying the user's single-App/free-team requirement is demonstrated.
Keep automaticSelfRenewalImplemented false; reminders, expiry display, opening external tools and mocked renewal responses do not satisfy this requirement.
deferredDeviceAcceptance: On an unmodified free-team signed iPhone, prove a same-device authenticated transport with computer off and no companion App.
Only after transport succeeds, obtain fresh profile/signature, replace the same App identity, cold launch and verify books/sources/progress survive.
Separately prove OS-permitted background triggering, bounded failure retry and expiry recovery; iOS scheduling cannot be represented as guaranteed precise execution.

workpackages.objective: Produce one source-free final candidate with exact evidence and a concise remaining device checklist.
desktopSimulatorAcceptance: After related edits settle, run the smallest relevant checks; share one prepared native payload and one iOS build across compatible groups.
Run broader ordinary-JAR native and UI acceptance when new integration requires it; do not repeatedly run unchanged suites or launch duplicate cloud builds.
Keep the existing native cancellation 15-second gate, 45-second operation deadline and seven actual wire requests unless the product contract itself changes with documented justification.
Independently review raw results and actual final IPA bytes, exclude private sources/credentials/tests, preserve original licenses and supply exact corresponding source/build materials.
Provide one candidate and one short device checklist; do not ask the user to test during the deferred-device period.
deferredDeviceAcceptance: Execute the deferred per-domain hardware checklist on this exact candidate; carry unresolved renewal feasibility and legal decisions explicitly.
